causalSequence: mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, warm water, olive oil to shaggy dough
knead ~5 min until soft, slightly tacky
rise until doubled: 60-90 min warm, or 12-24 h slow-rise with scant yeast
blend canned tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, salt raw; no-cook sauce
preheat oven as hot as it goes (475-550 F / 245-290 C) with stone, steel or tray inside, 30 min
punch down, divide dough (about 200 g per pizza), ball, rest 45-60 min
pat fresh mozzarella dry; slice or tear
dust peel or tray with semolina/cornmeal; stretch dough to 25-30 cm round, leave rim untouched
spread thin sauce layer (60-125 ml), keep 2-3 cm border
bake 5-12 min until crust browned, cheese blistered; optional 2-3 min broiler finish to char rim
rest 1-2 min; top with fresh basil, optional parmesan and olive-oil drizzle; slice
techniqueFacts: all four sources use a raw blended no-cook tomato sauce
all four add basil after baking, never before
three sources hold a long-preheated stone/steel at the oven's max temp is the crisp-crust lever
dough fork: overnight cold-ferment with 1/8 tsp yeast for flavour (s1) vs same-day 60-90 min rise with a full 7 g packet (s3)
pat fresh mozzarella dry or it waters out the pizza (s0)
sauce goes on thin, 60-125 ml per pizza; leftover keeps ~1 week refrigerated (s0, s1, s2)
brushing the shaped dough with olive oil before saucing guards against a soggy crust (s3)
broiler finish 2-3 min after the bake chars the rim like a pizzeria oven (s1)
no peel? use the back of a baking sheet, or bake on a cornmeal-dusted tray (s0, s2)
